name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A plug-in pack that turns an AI coding assistant into a professional security tester who tries to break into a website the same way a hired hacker would, but only against systems you're authorized to test.
buyer: An independent penetration tester or boutique security firm who wants to run more paid client engagements per month without hiring more testers.
business_use_cases: A freelance pentester uses it to run first-pass automated recon and exploit-pattern checks on a client's web app before manually verifying the scariest findings.
A security boutique bundles it into a fixed-price 'AI-assisted pentest' package for small SaaS companies that can't afford a traditional multi-week engagement.
A bug bounty hunter runs it against in-scope programs to surface candidate vulnerabilities faster, then writes up and submits the ones that check out.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a flat-fee 'AI-assisted security report' service for small SaaS startups, using this as the engine with a human verifying and delivering the final report

steal_this: Build a simple intake form where a client submits a staging URL and written authorization; the tool runs overnight, a human skims the output the next morning and ships a PDF report.
